name: Hunan Kaimeite Gases Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunan Kaimeite Gases Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells electronic specialty and mixed gases in China and internationally. The company offers high-purity carbon dioxide, hydrogen, liquefied petroleum gas, pentane, methane, oxygen, nitrogen, argon, helium, neon, krypton, and xenon under the KMT brand name. Its products are used in electronics, chemicals, beverages, food, tobacco, petroleum, metallurgy, agriculture, pharmaceutical, and industrial sectors. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Yueyang, China.
